<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I have received confirmation from Alison that the meeting has been booked for Thursday at 14:30. My final task is to send the confirmation email to all four partners.

I will use the `send_confirmation_email` function. The email needs to include the day, start time, and a body of text. I will make sure the email is professional and contains all the necessary information.

*   Day: Thu
*   Start time: 14:30
*   Body: I will compose a clear and concise email confirming the meeting details.

After sending the email, the task will be complete.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
